model.engine: ESS acceleration v2 (integration/ess-converged 9f4a292); launch presets not promoted (PR #18 QA-FAIL)

cg.basis: Typical 4×4 pickup, unladen. No ESS measurement. —  Indicative range 26–32.

grip.basis: Light-truck all-terrain / off-road tire (tire-type default; see acceleration validation).

cda.basis: Typical pickup Cd 0.40–0.50 × 28–38 ft² frontal area. —  Indicative range 12–19.

frontSpring.basis: Spring giving a typical 1.1 Hz front ride frequency (truck).

rearSpring.basis: Spring giving a typical 1.3 Hz rear ride frequency (truck).

frontMotion.basis: Short/long arm (double wishbone, upper/lower A-arms). Typical ranges for the architecture; motion ratio = spring travel ÷ wheel travel. Unsprung = per corner incl. wheel, tire, brake, half the links (live axle: half the axle). —  Indicative range 0.5–0.7.

rearMotion.basis: Live axle, five-link (four links + Panhard). Typical ranges for the architecture; motion ratio = spring travel ÷ wheel travel. Unsprung = per corner incl. wheel, tire, brake, half the links (live axle: half the axle). —  Indicative range 0.9–1.

frontUnsprung.basis: Short/long arm (double wishbone, upper/lower A-arms). Typical ranges for the architecture; motion ratio = spring travel ÷ wheel travel. Unsprung = per corner incl. wheel, tire, brake, half the links (live axle: half the axle). —  Indicative range 80–110.

rearUnsprung.basis: Live axle, five-link (four links + Panhard). Typical ranges for the architecture; motion ratio = spring travel ÷ wheel travel. Unsprung = per corner incl. wheel, tire, brake, half the links (live axle: half the axle). —  Indicative range 120–190.

tireRate.basis: Typical tire vertical rate for the vehicle type. —  Indicative range 1000–2400.

weight.basis: 2024 Toyota Tacoma US eBrochure — Manufacturer published curb figure. Driver, fuel state and equipment beyond the named configuration were not separately specified in the cited table.

front.basis: Layout class "awd-truck": Same pickup range; few calibration points. Low confidence.. —  Indicative range 0.55–0.61.

wheelbase.basis: 2024 Toyota Tacoma Hybrid TRD Pro instrumented test — Configuration specification as reported by the period test. A measurement is not independently documented for this field.

hp.basis: 2024 Toyota Tacoma US eBrochure — OEM combined hybrid system output, not ICE-only.

torque.basis: 2024 Toyota Tacoma US eBrochure — OEM combined hybrid system output, not ICE-only.

redline.basis: Peak-power rpm × 1.067 (Supercar X archive median, 64 cars; range ×1.00–1.16). —  Indicative range 6000–6950.

diameter.basis: 265/70R18: Nominal unloaded diameter from the size; loaded radius is smaller.

tire.basis: 2024 Toyota Tacoma Hybrid TRD Pro instrumented test — Configuration specification as reported by the period test. A measurement is not independently documented for this field.

frontTire.basis: 2024 Toyota Tacoma Hybrid TRD Pro instrumented test — Configuration specification as reported by the period test. A measurement is not independently documented for this field.
